extracted.name: Easy Artichoke Pasta
extracted.description: This easy artichoke pasta dish is simple to make with a can of artichoke hearts and basic pantry ingredients. Dinner for two in less than 30 minutes!
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered
instruction_lines: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 8 to 10 minutes.
While the pasta is cooking, heat butter and oil in a skillet over medium heat until butter melts. Add artichoke hearts, garlic, and basil; cook and stir until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Drain pasta. Add to the skillet and toss with artichoke mixture.
